description: Which checklists — the generic itinerary of requirements for an award — does this institution publish? Optional words (Computer Science, welding, computer) narrow them: they are read in the award title and the program's name, the checklist's and the program's descriptions, and the CIP's title and definition, and the checklists come back in that order (title and name matches first); or a program id. Each carries the program it belongs to, its printed notes, and its CIP code with the CIP's title and definition; pass one to get_checklist. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.
